name: Octen
description: Octen is search infrastructure built for AI agents. It gives Claude live web access with P50 search latency as low as 62ms and an index refreshed at minute granularity, so answers come from the web as it is now rather than from training data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Octen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Octen to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.octen.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Octen MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Octen provides these MCP tools: broad_search, extract, image_search, news_search, search, and video_search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Octen?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Octen in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Octen requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Octen is developed by Octen. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
